verdict.rationale: Docs confirm agents can be created, configured, and managed via API, CLI, and hosted MCP server without touching the dashboard (elevenlabs-agents-docs-1, -4, -38, -44), and phone number integration via SIP trunking is documented as an API-driven connection to existing phone systems (elevenlabs-agents-docs-12, -36, -60). However, there's no explicit evidence of an end-to-end flow that includes placing an outbound call programmatically via API/CLI/MCP — the quickstart even shows agent creation happening 'via the API or the web dashboard' rather than a fully agent-orchestrated pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of outbound call placement via API/CLI/MCP, and a single documented end-to-end workflow tying create→attach-number→call together without dashboard steps.
